label: 🔌 Export to JDBC
description: Write rows to any JDBC-accessible database — Oracle, DB2, MS SQL Server, Snowflake, Teradata, Vertica, etc. Requires a Java runtime on the host and a path to the driver JAR. Use the standard 'Export to database' step for Postgres / MySQL / SQLite via native Python drivers.

url.label: JDBC URL
url.help: Full JDBC URL — e.g. jdbc:oracle:thin:@//host:1521/ORCL · jdbc:sqlserver://host:1433;database=mydb

jarPath.label: Driver JAR path
jarPath.help: Absolute path to the .jar file (or a directory of jars).

mode.label: Write mode
mode.help: append = INSERT only · truncate_then_append = TRUNCATE then INSERT · drop_and_create = DROP then CREATE TABLE then INSERT

batchSize.label: Batch size
batchSize.help: Rows per JDBC executemany() call. Higher = faster but more memory.
